title: Cocycle and base change for the specified proper/open/proper graph comparisons
statement:
Fix a finite commutative ring $A$ and the ordinary unbounded constant-$A$ small-etale module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a map of arbitrary schemes with at least one supplied open-then-proper factorization. A presentation $t=(a,e,p)$ means a factorization $f=pea$ with $a:X\to U$ proper, $e:U\hookrightarrow P$ open, and $p:P\to Y$ proper [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-open-immersion]. Put $F_t=Rp_*De_!Ra_*$. An open-then-proper factorization $c=(j,q)$ is the presentation $(1_X,j,q)$. Use exact open extension and total derived direct image [lem-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero-exact, lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition]. For every such $c,t$ let $B_{t,c}:F_c\xrightarrow{\sim}F_t$ be exactly the product-graph comparison of [lem-sf-etale-locally-closed-graph-model], including its two open neighborhoods and their intersection, not an arbitrarily chosen isomorphism.
For presentations $s,t$, the isomorphism
$$C_{t,s}=B_{t,c}\circ B_{s,c}^{-1}:F_s\xrightarrow{\sim}F_t$$
is independent of the auxiliary open-then-proper $c$. It agrees with $B_{t,s}$ when $s$ is open-then-proper. Consequently $C_{s,s}=1$ and $C_{u,t}C_{t,s}=C_{u,s}$ for three presentations.
For a scheme map $b:Y'\to Y$, put $X'=X\times_Y Y'$ and $v:X'\to X$ [def-pc-fibre-product], and let $s_b,t_b$ be the pulled-back presentations. Define $\chi_t:b^*F_t\to F_{t_b}v^*$ by the successive canonical exchanges for the two proper factors and the inverse open-unit-normalized base-change mate for $e$ [def-kun-unbounded-exchange, lem-asd-open-base-change-unit-mate]. Then
$$\chi_t\circ b^*C_{t,s}=(C_{t_b,s_b}v^*)\circ\chi_s.$$
The same formula holds for the inverses of the comparisons. On quasi-compact $f$, for open-then-proper $s,t$, $C_{t,s}$ equals the canonical comparison through the common proper refinement: the unit--open-base-change comparison from $F_s$ to the refinement, followed by the inverse comparison from $F_t$ to that refinement, with the direction read as $F_s\to F_t$. More explicitly, if $\rho_s:F_s\to F_r$ and $\rho_t:F_t\to F_r$ are the canonical refinement comparisons, then $C_{t,s}=\rho_t^{-1}\rho_s$. In particular this is the specified map named rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationIso in the source library. The equations concern actual unbounded derived maps. No quasi-compactness is required except in this last identification with the refinement-based API; no Noetherianity or condition on residue characteristics is assumed.

proof.text: Apply pairwise-product graph normalization for auxiliary compactifications c and d with the same presentations s,t. Both right sides are lambda1(s,t);lambda2(s,t) inverse, independent of the auxiliary compactification. Transitivity gives the first clause.

source.place: Definition of C and the displayed pairwise-product equality

proof.text: For the second clause change the auxiliary compactification to d by the first clause. Unfold C and replace B(d,ofCompactification(d)) by openNormalization(d) inverse using diagonal normalization. Its inverse is openNormalization(d), giving the asserted equation.
For fixed c, C(s,s)=B_s inverse;B_s=id. Also C(s,t);C(t,r)=B_s inverse;B_t;B_t inverse;B_r=C(s,r), by associativity and cancellation.

Put E_s=N_c;B_s and E_t=N_c;B_t and use the analogous primed isomorphisms. Single-graph base change gives P(E_s);chi_s=chi_c;Q(E_s′) and likewise for t. Multiply the first equation by P(E_s inverse) and Q(E_s′ inverse) to obtain P(E_s inverse);chi_c=chi_s;Q(E_s′ inverse). Compose with the t equation. Since C(s,t)=E_s inverse;E_t by cancelling N_c, this is the forward base-change equation. Applying the same elementary inverse-exchange calculation to C gives its inverse equation. Here P and Q are the whiskering functors; no chi is inverted.

source.place: Tag 0F7F and cancellation of comparison isomorphisms

proof.text: For compactifications s,t with common refinement r, factor C(s,t)=C(s,r);C(t,r) inverse by cancellation. The open-normalization clause replaces these two factors by N_s;B(s,r) and N_t;B(t,r). Single-refinement normalization replaces B(s,r)=rho(rs);N_r inverse, and analogously for t. Cancel N_r inverse;N_r to obtain exactly N_s;rho(rs);rho(rt) inverse;N_t inverse.

For quasi-compact f choose r=Compactification.inf s t and the two supplied Cartesian refinement squares. The definition of rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationIso is rho(infFst);rho(infSnd) inverse, so the previous clause is the final named-iso clause.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleGraphComparisonBaseChange
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} (c : Compactification f) :
    (∀ (d : Compactification f) (s t : EtaleGraphPresentation f),
      etaleGraphComparison A c s t = etaleGraphComparison A d s t) ∧
    (∀ (d : Compactification f) (t : EtaleGraphPresentation f),
      etaleGraphComparison A c (EtaleGraphPresentation.ofCompactification d) t =
        etaleGraphOpenNormalization A d ≪≫ etaleGraphComparisonFromOpen A d t) ∧
    (∀ (s : EtaleGraphPresentation f), etaleGraphComparison A c s s = Iso.refl _) ∧
    (∀ (s t r : EtaleGraphPresentation f),
      etaleGraphComparison A c s t ≪≫ etaleGraphComparison A c t r =
        etaleGraphComparison A c s r) ∧
    (∀ {X' Y' : Scheme.{u}} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'} (v : X' ⟶ X) (b : Y' ⟶ Y)
      (sq : IsPullback v f' f b) (s t : EtaleGraphPresentation f)
      (s' t' : EtaleGraphPresentation f')
      (ds : s.BaseChange s' v b) (dt : t.BaseChange t' v b),
      Functor.whiskerRight (etaleGraphComparison A c s t).hom
          D((b)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]) ≫ etaleGraphPresentationExchange A dt =
        etaleGraphPresentationExchange A ds ≫
          Functor.whiskerLeft D((v)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A])
            (etaleGraphComparison A (c.ofIsPullback sq) s' t').hom ∧
      Functor.whiskerRight (etaleGraphComparison A c s t).inv
          D((b)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]) ≫ etaleGraphPresentationExchange A ds =
        etaleGraphPresentationExchange A dt ≫
          Functor.whiskerLeft D((v)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A])
            (etaleGraphComparison A (c.ofIsPullback sq) s' t').inv) ∧
    (∀ [QuasiCompact f] (s t r : Compactification f)
      (rs : r.Refinement s) (rt : r.Refinement t)
      (hs : IsPullback r.i (𝟙 X) rs.hom s.i)
      (ht : IsPullback r.i (𝟙 X) rt.hom t.i),
      etaleGraphComparison A c (EtaleGraphPresentation.ofCompactification s)
          (EtaleGraphPresentation.ofCompactification t) =
        etaleGraphOpenNormalization A s ≪≫
          asIso (rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationComparison
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) rs hs) ≪≫
          (asIso (rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationComparison
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) rt ht)).symm ≪≫
          (etaleGraphOpenNormalization A t).symm) ∧
    (∀ [QuasiCompact f] (s t : Compactification f),
      etaleGraphComparison A c (EtaleGraphPresentation.ofCompactification s)
          (EtaleGraphPresentation.ofCompactification t) =
        etaleGraphOpenNormalization A s ≪≫
          rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationIso A s t ≪≫
          (etaleGraphOpenNormalization A t).symm)
